We need answer user: "Write a Rust function that reads a text file and returns a HashMap of word counts (lowercased, split on whitespace), with proper error handling using Result."

Need provide Rust code. Need likely include function signature, use std::collections::HashMap, std::fs, std::io::Result maybe. Need proper error handling. Could return Result<HashMap<String, usize>, std::io::Error> or Box<dyn Error>. Since reading file and maybe parsing. Use fs::read_to_string(path) -> Result<String, io::Error>. Then split_whitespace, to_lowercase, count. Need maybe handle non-UTF8? read_to_string handles UTF-8. If want robust, read bytes and from_utf8? But user asks text file. Use io::Result
